verdicts.reason: A: the white frame sits empty at the far left while all the text is squeezed into a small stack over the busy flower, where it is low-contrast and hard to read; the headline is tiny, the order is jumbled ("Dear Gloria / you are invited to" ends up last), and one flourish is stranded at the bottom. B: the frame is also left empty and the text sits on the busy photo, but the BEAUTY TALKS headline is large and legible; still, "Dear Gloria" is unreadably small, "beauty is skin deep" is broken into one word per line, and the flourishes and Beautyhub are scattered.
